outputs.name: TphlVdd
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 80p 130p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: TplhVdd
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 130p 180p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: DelayVdd
outputs.expression: ((cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 80p 130p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil)) + (cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 130p 180p) (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil))) / 2

outputs.name: RiseVdd
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.9 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.1 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: FallVdd
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.1 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.9 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: RiseFallSkewVdd
outputs.expression: abs((cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.9 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) (0.1 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "rising" nil nil nil)) - (cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.1 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) (0.9 * VAR("VDD")) 1 "falling" nil nil nil)))

outputs.name: SupplyEnergyCycleVdd
outputs.expression: -VAR("VDD") * integ(IT("/VDD0/PLUS") cross(VT("/IN") (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 2 "rising" nil nil nil) cross(VT("/IN") (0.5 * VAR("VDD")) 3 "rising" nil nil nil))
